chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Abi Nasr, from Dawud ibn Sirhan, from Abu Abd Allah عليه السلام: regarding
A man who carried goods on his head and struck a person, and he died or suffered a fracture from it—he said: "He is liable."

key_terms.رَأْسِهِ: his head, indicating the manner of carrying the load
key_terms.فَأَصَابَ: then he struck or afflicted, causing harm
key_terms.فَمَاتَ: then he died as a result
key_terms.ٱنْكَسَرَ: he suffered a fracture or broken limb

ai.seo_question: Is a person liable if the load he is carrying injures or kills someone?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on liability for harm caused by carrying a load. If a person carrying goods on his head injures another person such that he dies or suffers a fracture, the carrier is held responsible.
